questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are only for buses and vehicles with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, it tells all riders to form a single line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or roadway go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit when conditions are bad.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop and give the right-of-way to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right ahead. Reduce your speed to the posted safe speed (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to indicate no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Obey the sign and do not make a right turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be merging into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks are ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must always wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are approaching a road with traffic flowing in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers of construction and maintenance work ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through work zones because conditions may be dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then left.
